description: Link two maps with Transfer Player events in both directions in one call. A door event is placed on each map; stepping on (or pressing OK at) the door on map A moves the player to map B's spawn tile and vice versa. Give each side its `door` tile; add `spawn` when the player should appear next to the door instead of on it (always do this for doors drawn into walls). Both maps are validated before anything is written, and a door is refused if another event already stands on that tile (allowOverlap overrides). Use twoWay=false for a one-way link (map A's door only). Check the result with render_map_image (doors show as blue markers) and list_map_connections.

door.description: Tile where this map's exit event is placed

spawn.description: Where the player appears when they ARRIVE on this map through the connection. Defaults to the door tile - give a spawn tile in front of the door when the door is in a wall.

direction.description: Facing on arrival: 0 keep, 2 down, 4 left, 6 right, 8 up

doorName.description: Event name prefix; default 'To <destination map name>'

sound.description: Sound effect to play before leaving, e.g. {name: 'Open1'}

trigger.description: touch = player walks onto the door tile, action = player presses OK facing it

twoWay.description: Create the return door on map B as well

name: connect_maps
title: Connect two maps
